page_title: UDI 1-1 NAP | Udinese v Napoli 06/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
90+4' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Udinese players have a reason to celebrate!
90+4' Wait! Referee Gianluca Aureliano has indicated he is going to review the Udinese goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+2' 1 - 1 GOAL! Thomas Kristensen meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Isaac Success (Udinese) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:1.
90+1' Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) trips an opposition player and Gianluca Aureliano signals a foul.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' Hassane Kamara will be replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
87' Francesco Calzona has decided to substitute Victor Osimhen and he is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
85' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

84' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.

84' He should have scored! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the right post is pretty weak and Maduka Okoye makes an easy save.
83' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) replaces Jesper Lindstrom.
81' The goal by Napoli is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
81' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Napoli players aren’t happy.
80' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
77' Victor Osimhen received a sweet pass from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli), but the advance is stopped.
76' Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Maduka Okoye.
75' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
75' Isaac Success (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
74' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
74' Isaac Success (Udinese) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
73' Substitution. Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jens Cajuste walks off.
72' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) whips in a vicious corner direct on goal, but the keeper makes a confident catch on the line.
71' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
70' The resulting corner from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is cleared. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
69' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is able to continue to play.
69' Here comes a substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue is given a rest as he is replaced by Festy Ebosele (Udinese).
69' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
68' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Victor Osimhen.
65' Great pass, great header, but no goal! Lazar Samardzic picked out Oier Zarraga (Udinese) on the penalty spot with a lofted pass and his bullet header was just inches over the bar.
62' Wasted effort! Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
62' Isaac Success (Udinese) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
61' Keinan Davis (Udinese) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Alex Meret sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
60' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
60' A nice individual effort by Isaac Success (Udinese) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Udinese will have a corner.

59' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
57' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
57' Looks like Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
56' Referee Gianluca Aureliano sees the trip by Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

55' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
54' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Keinan Davis (Udinese) replacing Lorenzo Lucca.
53' Here comes a substitution. Isaac Success (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Brenner.

51' 0 - 1 Matteo Politano displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Victor Osimhen (Napoli) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it in off the left post – 0:1.

49' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) receives the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
49' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Napoli earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
47' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
46' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Meret, who smothers the ball.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Gianluca Aureliano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
45+1' Matteo Politano (Napoli) wins himself enough space to connect with the rebound from the corner and fires the ball at goal from outside the box. The keeper does well to stop his effort.
45+1' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Chance! Jaka Bijol (Udinese) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
43' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
43' Brenner (Udinese) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Good work from Udinese as they win a corner.
42' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
42' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.

42' The Udinese players keep hold of the ball by exchanging some long passes. One inaccurate pass, however, surrenders possession. The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.
40' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.
38' Victor Osimhen receives a sweet cross inside the box from Mathias Olivera (Napoli), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
37' Walace (Udinese) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
36' Walace (Udinese) picks up an injury.
35' The ball rebounds out to Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
35' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
33' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
31' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) makes a strong challenge and Gianluca Aureliano blows for a foul.
30' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
29' Neat passing move from Napoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
26' The ball possession is 25:75.
23' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.

22' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Gianluca Aureliano blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
21' A crossfield pass from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
18' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
17' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent.
17' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
16' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Napoli.
15' Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul after Jaka Bijol (Udinese) hacks down one of his opponents. Napoli have a free kick from a promising distance.

14' Leo Ostigard (Napoli) attempts to find Mathias Olivera with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is behind the touchline and Napoli will take a throw-in.
13' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
9' Gianluca Aureliano blows the whistle, Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Udinese are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
9' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
7' Matteo Politano (Napoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
7' Matteo Politano (Napoli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Napoli win a corner.
6' The game is pretty dull as Napoli are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
4' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
1' Referee Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle and the match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Napoli will have the kick-off.
